sources.description: One prospect the Denver Broncos are showing interest in and may select in the second round of the 2026 NFL Draft is Oregon offensive lineman Emmanuel Pregnon. He is a 6-4, 314-pound offensive lineman who is considered one of the better interior blockers in the entire draft. The Athletic’s lead draft analyst, Dane Brugler, has […]
